The '''Imagecaster''' was a model of personal [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that was manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] at some point prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. These devices were commonly carried by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Imagecaster2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Imagecaster with arms extended.]]

The Imagecaster, a hand-held, disk-shaped [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]-projection device, comprised three curved arms fitted to a grilled projector plate; these arms could be extended in order to stand the Imagecaster on a level surface. The device could hold up to a hundred minutes' worth of images, though it was unable to send or receive transmissions&mdash;requiring the Imagecaster to be connected to another transmission device to be able to download images. It could also be connected to a pair of [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] for pseudo-real-time, face-to-face communication.

==History==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] carried an Imagecaster with him on his mission to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He later used the device to project an image of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] while bargaining with [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to obtain a [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]] for the vessel, which had been damaged in the escape from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

[[Rozatta]], owner of the [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]], owned an imagecaster belonging to her friend [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], where it recived a personal transmission from [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]] and saw a 5,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Komari Vosa]], the leader of the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]].
